title: Reverse the Words
statement:
Flip the order of the words in a line, keeping each word itself unchanged.

The input is one line with at least one word. Words are separated by one or more spaces, and the line may start or end with spaces. When a word appears more than once, keep every copy.

Input:

```text

```

Expected output:

```text
world big hello
```
